welcome_lead: Time to stretch — you'll classify life from kingdom to species, weigh up the evidence for evolution, and decide where you stand on GM ethics.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Linnaeus stacked life in 7 levels: Kingdom → Phylum → Class → Order → Family → Genus → Species.

Each species gets a two-word binomial name: Homo sapiens, Panthera leo.

Modern DNA evidence reshuffled things. Carl Woese proposed three domains:

1) Archaea (extreme microbes) 2) Bacteria 3) Eukarya (us, plants, fungi).

Three big clues: fossils (slow change over time), antibiotic resistance (evolution happening now), peppered moths (colour shift after pollution).

Selective breeding vs GM: powerful tools — but reduce gene pools and raise ethical questions.
